name: zob-core
description: Default ZOB supervised Orchestrator -> Lead -> Worker topology. Parent Pi keeps preflight, dispatch, output gates, and ledger ownership.

orchestrator.description: Parent-owned orchestrator that expands goals into lead and worker contracts without executing them in plan_only mode.
responsibilities: Perform preflight before any child dispatch.
Keep parent-owned ledger and completion gates.

leads.description: Plans discovery lanes and proposes bounded worker contracts.
responsibilities: Split the goal into read-only discovery tasks.

leads.description: Plans QA/oracle lanes and no-ship validation criteria.
responsibilities: Protect no-ship decisions when evidence is insufficient.

workers.description: Read-only mapper for relevant files, APIs, and gaps.
workers.taskTemplate: Explore the repo for goal: {goal}. Return files, answer, gaps, next_steps, evidence, risks/blockers, compliance, and deliverable_delivered. Run id: {run.id}.

workers.description: Researches local/official context and labels uncertainty.
workers.taskTemplate: Research local and provided context for goal: {goal}. Prefer official/local sources; state unknowns and safer wording. Run id: {run.id}.

workers.description: Plans or performs targeted verification when explicitly dispatched later.
workers.taskTemplate: Plan targeted QA evidence for goal: {goal}. Identify smallest safe commands and sentinel/artifact checks. Run id: {run.id}.

workers.description: Defines skeptical review lane and blocking evidence requirements.
workers.taskTemplate: Review acceptance and no-ship criteria for goal: {goal}. Return PASS/FAIL/WARN criteria, evidence needs, blockers, and compliance. Run id: {run.id}.
